text:
Alex G: Quick thought — can we try staggering owner handoffs for weekly triage? Propose primary + standby owners (split coverage). Also add a 10m review slot after triage for quick RFC/design checks. @Cheng L can you weigh in on impact to bug throughput? :thinking:

Nina T: I like the standby idea. Coverage is better if someone can jump in for quick fixes. 30m feels long though — can we do 20m triage + 10m review? :+1:

Cheng L: That makes sense. Our throughput drops in the last 10m when people leave. If we do 20m triage + 10m review, we can cut the queue faster. Need a clear owner for the review slot so it's not just noise.

Samir: Agree. Suggest rotating the standby weekly and keeping the primary for two weeks to maintain context. I can update the rota if we decide.

Alex G: OK proposed agenda:
```
- 20m: backlog triage (owner assigns bugs)
- 10m: quick RFC/design review slot (owner or reviewer on deck)
- 5m: action items + owners
```

Nina T: Can we trial this next week? I can be standby Mon/Wed.

Cheng L: I'll be primary Tue/Thu. @oncall-bot can you add a calendar reminder at T-15 for owners?

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly_triage_primary_chores, first reminder 1765558800

Samir: I'll publish the rota doc and ping infra to reserve the room for the extra 10m. Also, add a rule: review slot only for 1–3 small RFCs or design questions (<=10 slides / 5 mins each).

Alex G: Perfect. Let's trial for two weeks and collect quick metrics: number of bugs triaged, median time-to-assign, number of ad-hoc RFCs handled. I'll set up a tiny poll after week 1.

Nina T: Sounds good. Thanks!
